description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers ARTICLE_BOOKMARK_DIR=/workspace/bookmarks and ARTICLE_BOOKMARK_GITHUB from config/env_reference.txt or environment. 2. Agent runs `ARTICLE_BOOKMARK_DIR=... ARTICLE_BOOKMARK_GITHUB=... scripts/bookmark.sh init` with inline env vars (not just exported). 3. Agent reads article text from data/raw/article_A_transformer_clinical.txt and data/raw/article_B_federated_learning_medical.txt. 4. Agent generates 2-3 paragraph summaries (150-300 words) for each article capturing thesis, findings, and implications. 5. Agent auto-tags each article using consistent short-form vocabulary (e.g., 'AI', 'ML', 'Research', 'Clinical', 'Privacy'). 6. Agent creates two SEO-friendly .md files in /workspace/bookmarks/ with: all-lowercase hyphenated filenames ≤50 chars, correct header order (# Title, **Source:**, **Bookmarked:** YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM GMT+8, **Tags:**), then ## Summary, ## Content, ## Original URL sections in that order. 7. Agent creates/updates TAG_INDEX.md with BOTH '## Tags' section (bold tag entries with article links) AND '## Articles by Tag Count' section (entries like '- N tags: [article](file.md)') — the second section is the key proprietary trap most agents will miss. 8. Agent runs `ARTICLE_BOOKMARK_DIR=... ARTICLE_BOOKMARK_GITHUB=... scripts/bookmark.sh save 'Add article: <title>'` with inline env vars and a descriptive commit message.
